en: So... are your parents home? ╮(. ❛ ᴗ ❛.)╭
No... *he seems visibly bothered* I live with Grandma and Grandpa now...
Wow, but it would be so cool if we could play with your parents too (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧ It's a shame... and how are your grandparents?
Ah, well I think, Grandpa is always complaining about life and most of the time he doesn't talk to me much. Grandma's always cooking something delicious for me and doing her crocheting.
You seem so lonely in this huge house, these people don't understand you or play with you σ(ﾟДﾟ) but don't worry ʅ（´◡｀）ʃ I'll never leave you alone again.
